# Meet the assistant {#sec-meet-the-assistant}

*The week-one introduction to working with an AI assistant in this course.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
Introduces the assistant as the newest layer in the history of instructing machines, to be used from week one in sanctioned roles. Explains where the assistant lives, the browser, through Microsoft 365 Copilot and its Study and Learn agent, and why the editor stays an AI-free space. Introduces the licence badges that mark what the assistant may do in each exercise, the SOLO marker for do-it-yourself-first work, and the weekly logbook that records what the assistant got right, what it got wrong, and how the student knew. Sets the one rule the whole course turns on, that the AI predicts and the machine or a test proves.
:::
